notes.title: Achievement Bug Fix
notes.notes:
We have patched the game to fix an issue where achievements were not unlocking for some people. You may need to redownload the 18+ patch if you are playing with it.

We also fixed some issues were voiced lines were misaligned with the text.

Please let us know if you are continuing to have issues with the achievements or any other aspect of the game.

notes.title: Regarding the Recent Update
notes.notes:
We pushed an update to LAMUNATION! yesterday to add a Traditional Chinese translation and fix several bugs. Unfortunately, an error in the update process resulted in some users who downloaded the update having their save data wiped. This issue has now been resolved. We are very sorry for any inconvenience caused.

If you are using the 18+ patch, you will need to redownload the latest version in order for it to be compatible with the update: http://whitepowder.jp/patch/

As always, thank you for your support! LAMUNATION!!!

notes.title: Vocal Collection and Bug Fix!
notes.notes:
We hope you are all enjoying LAMUNATION! We have been truly blown away by the positive response!!

As an extra perk, we have released the game's Vocal Collection as DLC for just $0.99 (or your regional equivalent)! This includes the two OP tracks, plus some instrumental versions.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1047150/LAMUNATION_international_Vocal_Collection/

[u]Bug fix update[/u]

That being said, we have received reports of a number of bugs, and are endeavoring to fix them as soon as possible. We have patched an update to the Steam version today, as well as updating the external R18 patch.

Bug fixes in this update include:
-Fixing an issue where an alert would sound when closing the game
-Minor UI fixes
-Fixes to misaligned voices
-Fix to retain fullscreen settings
-Typos

We are still working to fix further issues! If you have encountered any bugs, please feel free to leave a response here or post on the forums.

-Meru (Love Lab, Inc.)
